title: A feasibility sieve for negative-energy binary-single direct scattering
exact_target: Characterize the incoming and outgoing Kepler data connected by negative-energy three-body scattering.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002557 (AIM-PHYSICS-0065). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 28.

status_qualification: Energy and angular-momentum conservation give necessary constraints rather than a full scattering characterization. The source’s asymptotic Kepler description is preserved; phase/time conventions and handling of channel exchange must be specified. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
